steps.instruction: Open http://127.0.0.1:8099/ghost/ and sign in with email admin@bench.local and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type that exact text into the password field). After signing in, go to the Posts list and report the titles of all published posts whose title starts with 'Seed:', exactly as shown on screen, one per line.

recorded.byline_shown: By Bench Admin in Bench Guides - 1 minute ago

steps.instruction: In the Ghost admin at http://127.0.0.1:8099/ghost/, create a new post titled exactly '{{runid}} Bench Post'. In the post body editor, type exactly one paragraph of text that includes the runid {{runid}} (for example: 'This bench post was created for run {{runid}} and confirms the flow works end to end.'). Make sure the paragraph appears only once in the body. Do NOT publish yet — leave it as a draft and save it (e.g. leave the editor / it autosaves). Report the post title and the body text you typed, and confirm the post is saved as a draft.

steps.instruction: In the Ghost admin, open the existing draft post titled '{{runid}} Bench Post' and open its post settings panel. In the settings panel: (1) In the Tags field, choose the EXISTING tag 'Bench News' from the suggestion dropdown — do not type a new tag into existence, and do not pick the similarly named 'Bench Newsletter'; the post's only tag must be 'Bench News'. (2) In the 'Custom excerpt' field, enter a short excerpt that includes the runid {{runid}} (e.g. 'A bench post for run {{runid}}.'). (3) Set the post's publish date to 2026-09-01 (date September 1, 2026). Then close/save the settings panel and report exactly what the settings panel shows for the tag, the custom excerpt, the publish date, and the URL slug field.

steps.instruction: In the Ghost admin, open the draft post titled '{{runid}} Bench Post' and publish it using the Publish button and its confirmation flow (confirm publishing, e.g. 'Publish post, right now' / confirm). Do not change the publish date, tags, excerpt, or body. After the publish flow completes, verify the post's status: it must be Published (not Scheduled, not Draft). Report the exact status shown, and confirm the post is publicly visible by loading its public URL http://127.0.0.1:8099/{{runid}}-bench-post/ and reporting the page title and whether the body paragraph and excerpt appear.
